title: A Landfall for the Current
author: Beatrix Nystrom
blurb: Paloma Almeida, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
